results.message: Do I have to attend every scheduled class in a month?

page_context.title: The Fortune Society | Digital Equity Program

response.message: No, regularly scheduled classes have rolling attendance, so you can attend as many or as few as you'd like. Multi-part workshops on special topics may require full attendance.

results.message: Can I walk into a regular class without registering?

page_context.title: The Fortune Society | Digital Equity Program

response.message: Yes, you can walk in to regularly scheduled classes without registering, though priority is given to those who register in advance. Specialized, multi-session workshops may require registration.

results.message: Can I get help with a digital skill that is not in the class catalog?

page_context.title: The Fortune Society | Digital Equity Program

response.message: Yes, you can contact us about the skill you'd like help with and we'll schedule one-on-one time, or visit the individual support page for open sessions and support desk hours.

results.message: Does every Fortune participant automatically get a laptop?

page_context.title: The Fortune Society | Digital Equity Program

response.message: No. Laptop access is limited, and participants need to attend at least 5 Digital Equity classes before receiving a laptop referral.

results.message: What does the Understanding Computers class cover?

page_context.title: The Fortune Society | Digital Equity Program

response.message: This service is currently not available; contact for more information. It covers how information flows through a computer, from input to processing, memory, storage, and output, and connects each stage to hardware and software.

results.message: I want to learn email from the beginning. What would the class teach me?

page_context.title: The Fortune Society | Digital Equity Program

response.message: The class covers creating or accessing an email account, navigating the inbox, and practicing reading, composing, sending, replying to, and forwarding emails with attachments. No email address is required prior to class.

sources.title: Intro to Email | FS Digital Equity

results.message: Do I need an email address before taking Intro to Email?
